## Outcome

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

Refs #

## Validation

Independent verification of the real behavior or artifact, scaled to the change.
Commands/scenarios exercised and their results. Link rendered evidence when relevant.
A green check or a successful compile is supporting evidence, not the verdict.

## Documentation and specification

Documentation updated (or why unnecessary); relevant plan only if one exists.
Explain any material deviation from the issue's acceptance criteria.

## Delivery

Delivery profile and release impact; rollback when applicable.
For standards maintenance, link the shared template decision and source revision.

## Review handoff

When ready, request a different authorized maintainer using GitHub review
requests. Address findings here and re-request review after revisions. Approval
without an independent verification receipt is not acceptance. A completed
coding turn or review request alone is not acceptance. Do not wait on the
product owner for ordinary findings, repaired acceptance, flake triage, or
review-bot comments.
